'''Rand''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] worker who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] with his [[Marriage/Legends|wife]] [[Ezra (Cold War)|Ezra]] in their later life. Rand was employed at the [[Rust Yards]], and the two lived in the nearby [[Rust Yards worker settlement|worker settlement]]. They once asked a passerby to retrieve and recharge used power units in the Rust Yards so that the couple could trade them for food.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rand and Ezra appear in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', where they give players the mission "Industrial Raiders" on Hutta.<ref name="TOR" />
